title: The live desktop
caption: The live desktop: KDE Plasma in Bone, the default accent, with the KDOS mascot as wallpaper.
alt: The KDOS desktop: a black wallpaper with a muscular penguin and the KDOS logo, an Install KDOS icon top left, and a panel along the bottom with Start, four workspaces, pinned applications, system meters and a clock.

title: Konsole and fastfetch
caption: Konsole running fastfetch, which names the system, the desktop, the accent and the hardware.
alt: A Konsole window in the middle of the desktop showing fastfetch: the KDOS logo and a pixel-art penguin beside lines for the OS, kernel, desktop, shell, accent, packages, CPU, memory and disk.

title: The Start menu
caption: The Start menu opens on favourites, with every application sorted into categories down the side.
alt: The Start menu open above the panel: favourites Firefox, Konsole, Dolphin, System Settings and Discover, categories from Development to Utilities, and the power buttons along its foot.

title: The Overview
caption: The Overview spreads out every window and the workspaces, and searches as you type.
alt: The Overview: Konsole, Kate and Dolphin shown side by side over the wallpaper, four workspace thumbnails along the top and a search field.

title: KRunner, the search box
caption: KRunner launches applications, runs commands and changes settings from one search box: typing accent offers the accents and the KDOS Look page.
alt: The KRunner search box at the top of the screen with the word accent typed, listing Switch the accent to the next one, to Phosphor, Amber, Ice, Bone, Norton and Borland, and the KDOS Look settings page.

title: Dolphin
caption: Dolphin, the file manager, with previews of the wallpaper each accent brings.
alt: Dolphin showing a Pictures folder of eight wallpaper previews, one per accent, with Places down the left side.

title: Kate
caption: Kate, the text editor, with C source code from the kdos-bb demo open.
alt: The Kate editor showing syntax-highlighted C code, with a file tab bar, line numbers and a minimap.

title: Okular
caption: Okular, the document viewer, reading the manual of kdos-doc, which opens the KDOS book that every machine carries.
alt: Okular showing a PDF of the kdos-doc manual page, with page thumbnails in a side bar.

title: Discover
caption: Discover, the software centre, which installs applications and system updates.
alt: The Discover window with categories down the left and seven Editor's Choice applications on its home page, among them KStars, Xournal++ and Meld.

title: An application in Discover
caption: Discover also offers applications KDOS does not build itself, such as Scribus, built from Debian's packages into a box of their own.
alt: Discover showing Scribus's page: an Install from Debian, built in a box button, its size and licence, a note that it is built on this computer from Debian packages in a box of its own, and its description.

title: KDOS Look
caption: The KDOS Look page in System Settings picks an accent and turns Phosphor mode on.
alt: System Settings on the KDOS Look page: eight accent swatches named Phosphor, Amber, Ice, Bone, Norton, Borland, Perfect and Paper, and the Phosphor mode switch with its presets.

title: The Phosphor accent
caption: Phosphor puts the whole desktop in green on near-black, like an early monochrome monitor.
alt: The desktop in the Phosphor accent, green on near-black, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme phosphor and the list of accents.

title: The Amber accent
caption: Amber puts the whole desktop in amber on warm black, the other classic monochrome monitor.
alt: The desktop in the Amber accent, amber on warm black, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme amber and the list of accents.

title: The Ice accent
caption: Ice puts the whole desktop in cyan and pale blue on blue-black.
alt: The desktop in the Ice accent, cyan and pale blue on blue-black, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme ice and the list of accents.

title: The Norton accent
caption: Norton puts the whole desktop in yellow and cyan on deep blue, after the Norton Commander file manager.
alt: The desktop in the Norton accent, yellow and cyan on deep blue, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme norton and the list of accents.

title: The Borland accent
caption: Borland puts the whole desktop in cyan and yellow on dark teal, after the Borland text-mode IDEs.
alt: The desktop in the Borland accent, cyan and yellow on dark teal, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme borland and the list of accents.

title: The Perfect accent
caption: Perfect puts the whole desktop in white on blue, after the WordPerfect editing screen.
alt: The desktop in the Perfect accent, white on blue, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme perfect and the list of accents.

title: The Paper accent
caption: Paper puts the whole desktop in blue ink on off-white paper, the one light accent.
alt: The desktop in the Paper accent, blue ink on off-white paper, with the Start menu open on the left and a Konsole window top right showing kdos theme paper and the list of accents.

title: Phosphor mode
caption: Phosphor mode draws the whole screen as a CRT, here in the Phosphor accent with scanlines and curved glass.
alt: The desktop drawn as a green-tinted CRT with scanlines and curved edges, showing Dolphin and a Konsole window running fastfetch.

title: The Dock desk
caption: Dock, one of the three desks (panel layouts), puts a bar at the top and a floating dock at the bottom.
alt: The desktop with a thin bar along the top and a small floating dock of application icons centred at the bottom, the penguin wallpaper between them.

title: The Tiling desk
caption: Tiling, another desk, lays windows out side by side by itself, under a bar along the top.
alt: Three windows tiled to fill the screen under a thin bar along the top: Konsole running htop on the left, Dolphin and Kate on the right.

title: The kdos command
caption: The kdos command reports the release, the accents and the state of the system, and changes them.
alt: Konsole showing the output of kdos version, kdos theme list and kdos status.

title: The text console
caption: The text console greets a login with the logo and the system's details in a large retro font.
alt: A full-screen text console: a login, then a large KDOS logo and a pixel penguin beside system details in a bold bitmap font.

title: kdos-bb, a 1997 text-mode demo
caption: kdos-bb, a text-mode demo from 1997 that ships with KDOS, playing its opening titles in Konsole.
alt: Two large letters B drawn in ASCII characters on a black terminal, from the opening titles of the kdos-bb demo, which also spell out AA presents, portable, demo, full and mode.

title: kdos-bb's text portraits
caption: kdos-bb draws portraits of its authors in nothing but text characters.
alt: A portrait of a man's face drawn in ASCII characters on a black terminal, with the start of his biography typed below it.

title: The boot menu
caption: The live medium's boot menu, counting down to the live session.
alt: A black boot menu with the KDOS logo at the top and four entries: KDOS Live, KDOS Live (clean session), KDOS Live (verbose) and Memory Test (memtest86+).

title: The boot splash
caption: The boot splash names each service as it starts, under a progress bar.
alt: The boot splash: the penguin and a large pixel KDOS logo, the words Kool Desktop Operating System 0.2, a progress bar and lines naming services with OK beside them.

title: The login screen
caption: The login screen of an installed system, here wearing the Phosphor accent chosen at install time.
alt: The SDDM login screen in green Phosphor colours: a large clock and date, the account KDOS Test with a password field, and a row of power buttons over the blurred penguin wallpaper.

title: The lock screen
caption: The lock screen, with the clock over a blurred wallpaper.
alt: The lock screen: a large clock and date, the user's name and a password field over a blurred penguin wallpaper.

title: Welcome Center, at first login
caption: Welcome Center opens on the first login; on the live system its first page starts the installer.
alt: The Welcome Center window over the desktop, with a large Install KDOS button and Skip and Next buttons.

title: The installer
caption: The installer's first page shows what it found: processor, memory, firmware, disks and the install size.
alt: The Install KDOS window on its Welcome page, with steps down the left and the computer's details on the right.

title: Choosing a disk
caption: The Disk page erases a disk or reuses partitions, with two system slots so that an update can be undone.
alt: The installer's Disk page listing one disk, with the option to erase it and install KDOS and a Two system slots check box.

title: Choosing a look
caption: The Look page picks the accent and the desk before the first login.
alt: The installer's Look page with eight accent previews and small drawings of the three desks.
